caption: Creamy beige tonkotsu broth with floating noodles and green onions, topped with dark, glossy nori and tender, pale pink chashu pork. Served in a white ceramic bowl with blue geometric pattern and raised rim on a reddish-brown wooden table.

segments_info.text: The table is a smooth, reddish-brown wooden surface with subtle grain patterns and slight reflections.
Chashu pork: tender, pale pink slices with glossy surface, slightly curled edges, and visible marbling.
The nori seaweed is dark, glossy, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly rough, textured surface with visible folds.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy beige, glossy, with visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
White ceramic bowl with blue geometric pattern and slightly raised rim, smooth surface with faint residue.
